privacy.page_description: How RaiseHER collects, uses, and protects your data.
privacy.headline: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: RaiseHER is built for women who deserve straight answers. This policy tells you exactly what we collect, how we use it, and what we will never do with it.
privacy.s1_body: RaiseHER is an independent software product. Our service is available at raiseher.app. We operate under applicable data protection laws including GDPR (EU/UK users) and CCPA (California residents).
privacy.s2_body: Account information: your email address and the password hash managed by Clerk. Usage data: which features you use, when you log in, general device and browser type. Data you choose to enter: your job role, industry, years of experience, salary figure, location, wins, and any outcomes you report to the Circle. The Circle data is anonymized before it is aggregated.
privacy.s3_body: We use your data to provide the RaiseHER service, to generate your pay gap analysis, to power the AI features, to send product updates if you opt in, and to improve the product. We analyze aggregate, anonymized usage patterns to understand which features help women most.
privacy.s4_body: We will never sell your data. We will never share your individual salary figures or win descriptions with any third party. We will never use your data to train external AI models. The pay gap analysis is generated by Google Gemini using your inputs as a one-time prompt. Your data is not stored by Google for training.
privacy.s5_body: Clerk handles authentication and stores your email and authentication credentials. Convex stores your wins, pay gap results, rehearsal sessions, and case files. Stripe processes payments and stores your payment method directly. We never see your full card number. Google Gemini generates AI analysis via API calls.
privacy.s6_body: Your account data is retained for as long as your account is active. You can delete your account at any time from Settings. When you delete your account, all your wins, pay gap results, rehearsal sessions, and case files are permanently removed within 30 days. Authentication records held by Clerk are deleted in parallel.
privacy.s7_body: You have the right to access the personal data we hold about you, to correct inaccurate data, to request deletion, and to export your data. To exercise these rights, use the Settings screen in the app or contact us at the address below. EU and UK users may also lodge a complaint with their local data protection authority.
privacy.s8_body: We use one functional cookie to remember your preferred language (RAISEHER_LOCALE). We use authentication session cookies managed by Clerk. We do not use advertising cookies or third-party tracking cookies.
privacy.s9_body: RaiseHER is not directed at children under 16. We do not knowingly collect data from anyone under 16. If you believe a child has created an account, contact us and we will remove it promptly.
privacy.s11_body: We will notify you by email or in-app notice before making material changes to this policy. Continued use after a change takes effect means you accept the updated policy.

terms.page_description: The terms that govern your use of RaiseHER.
terms.headline: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of RaiseHER. By creating an account you agree to them. They are written in plain language on purpose.
terms.s1_body: You must be at least 18 years old. You must be a human (no bots or scrapers). You must not use RaiseHER to harm, deceive, or harass anyone. You agree to provide accurate information when you create your account.
terms.s2_body: RaiseHER provides pay gap analysis, a wins log, AI-assisted rehearsal, case file generation, and an anonymized community outcomes tracker. All AI-generated analysis is based on aggregated public labor-market data and is provided for informational purposes only. It is not legal advice, financial advice, or a guarantee of any outcome.
terms.s3_body: You are responsible for keeping your password secure. You are responsible for everything that happens under your account. If you suspect unauthorized access, change your password immediately and contact us.
terms.s4_body: Season Pass and Teams Pilot are annual plans billed through Stripe. Payments are charged upfront. Annual plans auto-renew unless you cancel before the renewal date. We do not offer partial refunds on annual plans. If you have a billing problem, contact us within 14 days of the charge and we will work it out.
terms.s5_body: You own the content you enter into RaiseHER: your wins, your inputs, your described outcomes. You grant us a limited license to store and process that content to provide the service. We do not claim any ownership over your data.
terms.s6_body: The RaiseHER name, product design, code, and AI prompts are owned by RaiseHER. You may not copy, resell, reverse engineer, or redistribute any part of the product.
terms.s7_heading: What we are not liable for
terms.s7_body: RaiseHER is a tool, not a guarantee. We are not liable for negotiation outcomes, employment decisions, salary changes, or any other real-world results that follow from using the app. AI analysis reflects aggregate data and may not reflect your individual situation. Use your own judgment.
terms.s8_body: You can close your account at any time from Settings. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms, without prior notice for serious violations. If we terminate your account without cause, we will refund the unused portion of any paid plan.
terms.s9_body: These terms are governed by the laws of Delaware, USA. Disputes will be resolved by binding arbitration under the AAA Consumer Arbitration Rules, with hearings held remotely.
terms.s10_body: We will notify you by email before making material changes. Continued use after changes take effect means you accept the updated terms.
